title: CI source-gates never runs 36 top-level test files or test/e2e/release -- a green PR says nothing about them
description: Found 2026-09-25 while wiring QCLI-292. The required source-gates context runs scripts/qualification/prepublish.mjs, whose runSourceGates runs bun test on SEVEN paths only: test/domain, test/contract, test/integration, test/cli-tracker-process.test.ts, test/fault/git/local-git.test.ts, test/e2e/migration, test/scale. No workflow runs the full suite. Grep of .github/workflows for bun test finds only projection-platform.yml running one sqlite file. So `ls test/*.test.ts` (36 files at d739f60, including every qcliNNN regression test: qcli300 CI wrapper gate, qcli304, qcli314 promotion fast-forward, qcli346, qcli371 plugin tests, etc.) and all of test/e2e/release/ (publish-release, registry-visibility, e2e-receipt) run ONLY when someone runs bun run check locally. A PR that breaks any of them goes green in CI. OBJECT MEASURED: prepublish.mjs runSourceGates at this branch, and .github/workflows/*.yml. NOT MEASURED: whether any of those files currently fails (local bun run check passes with 660 tests, so none do today). QCLI-292 gated its own check by adding a dedicated lockfile_pins gate rather than relying on its test file, for exactly this reason.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every test file under test/ is run by a required CI context, or is listed with a written reason for being excluded
A test deliberately broken in a top-level test/*.test.ts file turns the required context red, and the same PR with the break reverted turns it green (two measurements)
The prepublication qualification record still names each gate, so a failure says which suite broke

plan: 1. Replace the fixed seven-path loop in runSourceGates with named gates that cover every test file: keep the seven, add release (test/e2e/release) and top_level (each test/*.test.ts not already covered, enumerated at run time).
2. Add a test_coverage gate that enumerates every *.test.ts under test/ and fails naming any file no gate runs and no written exclusion covers, so a new directory cannot escape silently.
3. Measure locally: runtime of the newly-run files, and whether any needs network, macOS, or touches the darwin-arm64 binary.
4. Two CI measurements on the PR: a deliberately broken top-level test turns source-gates red naming the top_level gate; the revert turns it green. Cite run ids only once concluded on the final head.
5. Correct the workflow comment that claims source-gates runs the full test suite.
implementationNotes: HANDOFF on recycle, 2026-09-25, orchestrator-requested. THIS IS THE NEXT TASK: the orchestrator ruled it goes first for the successor. Not started, no branch. STATE (verified by fetch just now): origin/main == origin/dev == 86d931b, 0 open PRs. This session landed and promoted QCLI-349 (#270/#271), QCLI-350 (#273), QCLI-304 (#275), QCLI-292 (#277); promotion PRs #269 #272 #274 #276 #278. WHAT IS ESTABLISHED: source-gates runs scripts/qualification/prepublish.mjs, and runSourceGates runs `bun test` on 7 paths only. No workflow runs the full suite: grepping .github/workflows for bun test finds only projection-platform.yml running one sqlite file. So the top-level test/*.test.ts files (36) and test/e2e/release/ run only on a local `bun run check`. APPROACH I would take: add one more gate to runSourceGates (e.g. ["top_level", "test/*.test.ts"] plus ["release", "test/e2e/release"]), or run full `bun test` as a single gate. First measure its CI runtime, and whether any file needs network or macOS. The darwin-arm64 binary AMFI SIGKILL trap (CLAUDE.md profile) matters if a test hash-objects npm/. Prove it with TWO CI runs: a deliberately broken top-level test goes red, the revert goes green (AC2). LESSONS from this session: (1) cite a CI run id only after it concludes, on the final head; a later push cancels in-flight runs (see QCLI-349 correction, #271). (2) The trunk-guard hook reads HEAD before a compound command runs, so create the branch in its own command before committing. (3) A test file under test/ is NOT a CI gate by itself; that is this task. (4) When editing package.json with python json.dump, pass ensure_ascii=False or it escapes the em dash in description; prefer a sed line insert. SKILLS: opum-workflow:opum-sdlc, opum-quest:quest, opum-workflow:opum-handoff restore.
